summary: Relais Group Oyj operates as a consolidator and acquisition platform for the vehicle aftermarket in Finland, Sweden, Estonia, Norway, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Finland&Baltics and Scandinavia. The company provides commercial vehicle services, such as repair, maintenance, and service solutions for commercial vehicles and industrial equipment; and distributes spare parts, vehicle equipment, and technical solutions for commercial vehicles and professional mobility. Relais Group Oyj was founded in 1996 and is based in Helsinki, Finland.
